name: get_invoices
description: List all invoices (GET /v1/invoices) Declared lifecycle: invoices.status: draft → open → paid → uncollectible → void.

collection_method.description: The collection method of the invoice to retrieve. Either `charge_automatically` or `send_invoice`.

created.description: Only return invoices that were created during the given date interval.

customer.description: Only return invoices for the customer specified by this customer ID.

customer_account.description: Only return invoices for the account representing the customer specified by this account ID.
